title: AR48014: Documentation Of Innovative Details
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Documentation of at least 25 details of innovative details from personal
observations, office records or field studies. This may include historical as
well as contemporary details. Critical observations of performance, usefulness
etc. The selection of details should be based on their special nature due to
practical field situation and must be presented in a folder.
